title: Google narrows planned goo.gl deactivation scope
summary: Google revised its earlier plan to discontinue all goo.gl URLs and limited deactivation to links that had shown no activity in late 2024 and had received the deactivation warning interstitial.
migration_path: Migrate any link that displays Google's deactivation warning to another URL before relying on it after the stated boundary.
user_impact: Only the targeted inactive-link subset is deactivated; other goo.gl links continue functioning, so universal removal must not be inferred.
notes: This event records the scope correction, not universal removal.
